title: Editorial Comic Art Portfolio Landing Page

analysis.title: Editorial Comic Art Portfolio Landing Page
analysis.notes: An ivory editorial layout combines deep red accents, black ink illustration, ornamental rules, and carefully aligned portfolio grids. The composition balances a large fantasy illustration with process diagrams, featured work cards, and restrained navigation.
analysis.heroPrompt: A dramatic editorial hero illustration for a comic artist portfolio: a solitary armored fantasy warrior shown in three-quarter view, head bowed, windswept dark hair, layered black cloak and intricate metal armor, standing before a large muted crimson sun with distant gothic architecture and flying birds. Render with expressive hand-inked linework, dense crosshatching, distressed brush textures, splattered edges, and cinematic rim light. Use an ivory paper background with generous negative space on the left for typography; refined red, charcoal, and warm gray palette; sophisticated print-poster composition, no logos, no readable text, no existing characters.
